mapper.sql:
s.id, s.series_name, s.cover_file_id, s.description, s.status, s.author_username, s.create_time, s.update_time, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.id IS NOT NULL
AND a.status = '1'
THEN r.article_id END) AS article_count
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM pb_series s LEFT JOIN pb_sa_relation r ON r.series_id = s.id AND r.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN pb_article a ON a.id = r.article_id AND a.del_flag = '0' WHERE s.del_flag = '0'
AND s.status = '0'
AND s.author_username = #{username}
AND (s.series_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR s.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY s.id, s.series_name, s.cover_file_id, s.description, s.status, s.author_username, s.create_time, s.update_time ORDER BY article_count DESC, s.update_time DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT FROM pb_series s LEFT JOIN pb_sa_relation r ON r.series_id = s.id AND r.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN pb_article a ON a.id = r.article_id AND a.del_flag = '0' WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.del_flag = '0'
AND s.status = '0'
AND s.author_username = #{username}
GROUP BY s.id, s.series_name, s.cover_file_id, s.description, s.status, s.author_username, s.create_time, s.update_time

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_file_id, a.author_username, a.author_nickname, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.sticky, a.featured, a.published_at, a.status, r.sort_order FROM pb_sa_relation r INNER JOIN pb_article a ON a.id = r.article_id WHERE r.series_id = #{seriesId} AND r.del_flag = '0' AND a.del_flag = '0'
AND a.status = '1'
ORDER BY r.sort_order ASC, r.id ASC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_file_id, a.author_username, a.author_nickname, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.sticky, a.featured, a.published_at, a.status FROM pb_article a WHERE a.author_username = #{username} AND a.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY a.published_at DESC, a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC
